notes: S2-FIX6 (decision 2026-11-16 #13; §5.3, §9.1 rule 3; F85, review A probe P4): the owner's only declaration carries a human-2 entry whose equation fails (invalid E_SIG_INVALID), so it supplies no material and the owner does not resolve. The device declaration is self-signed and cosigned by the owner key with a signature that would verify; that cosignature has no material (unverified, N_KEY_UNDECLARED) and the device declaration is unverifiable E_KEY_UNKNOWN.
